en.title: Dengue spike: nine deaths in 24 hours
en.text: Bangladesh is facing a severe dengue outbreak with nine deaths in a single day and over 1,900 people hospitalised. Health authorities are on high alert.

en.title: Over 21 migrant worker bodies daily
en.text: Bangladesh faces an ongoing tragedy as more than 21 migrant worker bodies return home every day on average, raising serious concerns about worker safety abroad.

bn.title: প্রতিদিন ২১+ প্রবাসী মৃত্যু

en.title: Bangladesh approves Durga Puja holiday break
en.text: Bangladesh has approved a five-day continuous break in October for Durga Puja celebrations, giving communities time to observe the major festival.
